test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 17 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Who among the following sports persons is designated as brand ambassador for Nikshay Mitra, an initiative under Pradhan Mantri TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyan by Ministry of Health and Family welfare of GOI in November 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Deepa Malik**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Deepa Malik** is a renowned Indian athlete who has won numerous accolades in para-athletics.
 
• She is the first Indian woman to win a medal in the Paralympic Games.
 
• She has been honored with the Padma Shri and Arjuna Award for her contributions to sports.
 
• As a brand ambassador for the Nikshay Mitra initiative, she plays a crucial role in promoting the eradication of tuberculosis in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pradhan Mantri TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyan**

 
 
• The Pradhan Mantri TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyan is a significant initiative by the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India, aimed at eliminating tuberculosis (TB) from the country by 2025.
 
• The campaign emphasizes the need for community involvement, awareness, and support to combat TB effectively.
 
• The Nikshay Mitra initiative is part of this larger campaign, where individuals, institutions, and corporate entities can adopt TB patients and ensure they receive the necessary nutrition, medical care, and support for complete recovery.
 
• The initiative aims to provide a holistic approach to TB treatment, focusing not just on medical interventions but also on the social and nutritional needs of patients.
 
 
 
• **Mary Kom**
 
 
• Mary Kom is an Indian Olympic boxer and a multiple-time World Amateur Boxing champion.
 
• She has received the Padma Bhushan, Padma Shri, and Arjuna Award for her contributions to boxing.
 
• Though she is an iconic sports figure, she is not the brand ambassador for the Nikshay Mitra initiative.
 
 
 
• **Abhinav Bindra**
 
 
• Abhinav Bindra is an Indian shooter and the first Indian to win an individual gold medal at the Olympic Games.
 
• He has been awarded the Padma Bhushan, Padma Shri, and Arjuna Award.
 
• Bindra has significantly contributed to Indian sports but is not associated with the Nikshay Mitra initiative.
 
 
 
• **Pullela Gopichand**
 
 
• Pullela Gopichand is a former Indian badminton player and the chief national coach for the Indian Badminton team.
 
• He has been awarded the Padma Bhushan, Padma Shri, and Dronacharya Award.
 
• Gopichand is known for his coaching prowess but is not the brand ambassador for the Nikshay Mitra initiative.
